entries.title: Exodus 39:32
segments: When numbers unite earnestly and perseveringly in a good work, much, with the blessing of God, may be accomplished in a short time.

entries.title: Exodus 39:37
segments: To be set in order; or, arranged in order, that is, in a row.

entries.title: Exodus 39:42
segments: When things are undertaken and accomplished according to the directions of God, they will be done in the best manner.

entries.title: Exodus 39:43
segments: When others have done will we should show ourselves pleased, ask God to bless them, and give to him the glory.
